default.notes: Apply online for a tourist eVisa (typically 30 days, extendable) on evisa.mfa.ir, or — if arriving by air — obtain a visa on arrival at major international airports. VOA is never issued at land borders, and compliant travel insurance is checked.

groups.notes: Visa-free entry under Iran's bilateral and unilateral waivers. Permitted stays vary by nationality (commonly 15 to 90 days) and some newer waivers apply to air arrivals only — confirm the current terms for your passport on evisa.mfa.ir before travel.

US, UK and Canadian citizens cannot use the eVisa or visa on arrival — the visa must be arranged through an Iranian mission (or interests section) with a Ministry of Foreign Affairs authorisation code, travel is permitted only on a guided tour with a licensed operator, and fingerprints are taken on arrival.

IR.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Iranian citizens.

IL.notes: Israeli passport holders are not admitted to Iran under any circumstances, and evidence of travel to Israel in any passport leads to refusal of entry.

AF.notes: Afghan nationals must obtain a visa from an Iranian consulate before travel — special documentation rules apply; confirm requirements with the nearest Iranian mission.
